heat_index.label: Heat index
heat_index.about: How hot it feels, from temperature and humidity (Rothfusz regression).

pm25.label: PM2.5
pm25.about: Fine particulate matter, a main driver of air-pollution harm.

no2.label: NO2
no2.about: Nitrogen dioxide from traffic and combustion.

drought_index.label: Drought index
drought_index.about: 30-day rainfall deficit against the city's climate; higher means drier.

tmax.label: Maximum temperature
tmax.about: Hottest 2 m air temperature of the day (state-level ERA5).

solar.label: Solar radiation
solar.about: Sunlight reaching the surface, a state-level ERA5 daily mean.

cloud.label: Cloud cover
cloud.about: Share of sky covered by cloud, 0 to 1 (state-level ERA5 daily mean).
